verdict.rationale: Pigment's own Analyst Agent is documented as monitoring the business, surfacing what matters, and building reports from conversations inside the product, which covers the AI-generated insights half of the story. AI-generated suggestions or recommendations are not explicitly documented, and all evidence is vendor marketing. missing for 10: explicit in-product AI suggestions/recommendations from data, in-depth docs on how Analyst Agent insights are generated and presented, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: The Analyst Agent continuously monitors your business, uncovers what matters and builds reports from simple conversations
